blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Marcos believes the Philippine hosting of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits was a success since key declarations, like a unified stand against online sexual abuse and exploitation of children (OSAEC), were adopted. In a press briefing on Tuesday, after the closing ceremonies for the 49th Asean summit, Marcos said that over a hundred outcome documents were completed during the three-day meeting, which started on Sunday. “Our discussions over the past three days have been very productive, very candid, yet focused, resulting in impactful decisions that address the critical issues of […]...
